derivation.core_struct: 10 world files x 6 questions each = 60 questions: 10 all_causes_of/all_effects_of list tasks and 50 yes/no qualification questions.
derivation.core_decision: 60 decision worlds x 1 task = 60 decision Core tasks.
derivation.guess_struct: 30 world files x 6 questions each = 180 questions: 30 list-query Core tasks and 150 Qual questions.
derivation.guess_decision: 48 decision worlds x 1 task = 48 decision Core tasks.

track_to_question_projection.interpretation: World-file rows, questions and benchmark scoring denominators are separate units. Never report 148 world entries as 148 agent tasks or add Core/Guess task counts as independent worlds.

evaluator_reproduction.diagnostic_parser_arm: Strict typed JSON / deterministic parser is an additional lane only; never substitute its score for the official evaluator.
evaluator_reproduction.independent_adjudication: Blindly adjudicate a stratified sample of raw outputs and extracted answers; report parser disagreement, extraction error and human agreement separately.

core: decision regret where oracle utility admits it
measurement_validity: Newcombe interval from Wilson score intervals
detection power at preregistered effect sizes

statistical_design.unit: Question-level paired comparisons nested within content-addressed world; bootstrap/resample by world rather than treating questions from one PGM as independent.
statistical_design.pairing: Same model snapshot and agent arm answer the same active Core/Qual task identities for paired four-turn comparisons. Guess-only is scored on its separate larger official task sets.
statistical_design.overlap_control: 10 core_struct payloads are exact duplicates in guess_struct; two decision-track filenames collide but payload digests differ. Keep full track path, task ID and payload SHA-256. Do not treat duplicated worlds or tasks as independent.
statistical_design.parser_control: Keep parser model/revision/prompt fixed across candidate agents; parser-variant results are a separate diagnostic factorial.
statistical_design.model_control: Pin provider/model snapshot, reasoning settings, temperature, system prompt, tools, output token budget, serving date and retries.
statistical_design.cost_control: Report model tokens, tool calls, samples, code execution rounds, wall-clock, parser calls and monetary cost.
statistical_design.confidence_intervals: Use world-clustered bootstrap intervals; preserve complete denominators, skipped tasks, timeouts, invalid answers and parser failures.
statistical_design.multiplicity: Predeclare Core and Qual primary outcomes; correct secondary archetype/question-type comparisons for multiplicity.

proposed_targets.baseline_reproduction: Reproduce the official 0.94 Core / 0.98 Qual best-agent result and 0.96 / 1.00 question-targeted active-learning result within uncertainty before any superiority claim.
proposed_targets.primary_stretch: Match or exceed 0.96 Core and retain 1.00 Qual under the same four-turn interface, while improving hardest decision and graph-size strata; confirm on independently generated seeds.
proposed_targets.budget_normalized: On the 5,000-row arm, match or improve the paper's Active+Code decision-task results at lower cost or better worst-group accuracy; do not conflate row budget with turn budget.
proposed_targets.safety: Zero violations on held-out safety-constrained negative controls; report false denials and utility/regret separately.

security_boundary: Candidate agents see only scenario text, variable metadata, non-intervenability annotations, declared question and their own returned sample outputs.
Hidden PGM, CPDs, graph edges, generator seed, oracle answer, scoring roles and evaluator state remain outside the candidate process.
No untrusted candidate code runs in the host process or inside the upstream process-only sandbox. Candidate code execution requires a separately qualified isolated microVM/sandbox.
The upstream parser and world model are evaluator services; all requests and responses are typed, budgeted and receipted.
claim_ceiling: The protocol records official ACED-Query reproduction requirements and new diagnostics. The world metadata qualifier does not execute agents, reproduce paper results, prove sandbox security or establish a Symthaea SOTA result.
